players.note: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

players.name: Chris Brooks
players.note: As Week 10 approaches, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com indicates that Brooks (ankle) may be ready to return from IR.

players.name: Xavier Legette
players.note: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Legette (knee) will be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Isaiah Davis
players.note: Davis didn't play any offensive snaps in Sunday's 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.

players.name: George Holani
players.note: Holani didn't log any touches or targets Sunday in a 17-3 win over Arizona.

players.name: Andrei Iosivas
players.note: Head coach Zac Taylor said Monday that Iosivas is doing well in his recovery from left thumb surgery, and the Bengals will "continue to work through this week" to determine when the receiver might return from injured reserve, Laurel Pfahler of the Dayton Daily News reports.

players.name: Nicholas Singleton
players.note: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that Singleton is "getting better," and the rookie running back could be a candidate to see added opportunities in the second half of the season if lead back Tony Pollard is dealt ahead of Tuesday's deadline, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com

players.name: Demond Claiborne
players.note: ir

players.name: Kaytron Allen
players.note: Allen caught a 46-yard pass in Sunday's 19-9 loss to the Lions. He rushed one time for minus-one yards.

players.name: DJ Giddens
players.note: Giddens did not appear in Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys.

players.name: Shedeur Sanders
players.note: Sanders completed 19 of 31 passes for 297 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints. He added 28 yards on 10 carries.

players.name: Adam Randall
players.note: Randall (neck) is officially listed as questionable for Thursday's game versus the Jaguars, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

players.name: James Conner
players.note: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Tuesday that Conner (foot) won't return from IR this week, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Erick All Jr.
players.note: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

players.name: Ja'Tavion Sanders
players.note: Sanders recorded zero targets during Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

players.name: Tanner McKee
players.note: McKee (ribs) is active for Sunday's game against the Giants.

players.name: Odell Beckham Jr.
players.note: Beckham is active for Monday's game against the Bills, Ben Goessling of The Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

players.name: Kendrick Bourne
players.note: Arizona placed Bourne (tibia) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

players.name: Dyami Brown
players.note: The Commanders placed Brown (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Hollywood Brown
players.note: Brown finished Sunday's loss to the Commanders with two catches for 17 yards on two targets.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: out

players.name: Josh Whyle
players.note: out

players.name: Tanner Koziol
players.note: Koziol finished Thursday's 33-10 win over Baltimore with two catches for 15 yards on two targets.

players.name: Tyler Huntley
players.note: Huntley (toe) was placed on injured reserve Thursday.

players.name: Gardner Minshew II
players.note: Per Adam Schefter of ESPN, Minshew (elbow) is reportedly seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he likely will require season-ending surgery to address a torn UCL.

players.name: Mason Rudolph
players.note: Rudolph is active for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

players.name: Jeremy McNichols
players.note: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Christian Kirk
players.note: The 49ers placed Kirk (knee) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Case Keenum
players.note: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the Bears' emergency No. 3 quarterback for Sunday Night Football versus the Buccaneers.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: The 49ers reinstated Aiyuk (personal) from the reserve/left squad list Monday and were granted a two-week roster exemption for the wide receiver, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

players.name: Elijah Moore
players.note: Moore did not garner a target during Sunday night's 27-10 loss to the Commanders.

players.name: Roschon Johnson
players.note: Johnson carried five times for 17 yards and added an 11-yard reception on his lone target in Monday's 34-17 win over the Seahawks.

players.name: Chris Blair
players.note: Blair went without a target while playing nine of the Falcons' 53 offensive snaps in Sunday's 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers.

players.name: Tyrell Shavers
players.note: Shavers (knee) was not activated from the reserve/PUP list ahead of Monday night's matchup with Minnesota, per the NFL's official transaction log.

players.name: Dillon Gabriel
players.note: Gabriel "will serve as the backup quarterback" Sunday against the Saints, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jalen Milroe
players.note: Milroe will get added reps at practice ahead of Sunday's matchup with the Cardinals, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

players.name: Beaux Collins
players.note: Collins (hip) is listed as active Sunday against the Bengals in Madrid, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

players.name: Bauer Sharp
players.note: Sharp went without a target while playing 19 of the Buccaneers' 60 snaps on offense in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

players.name: Joe Fagnano
players.note: Fagnano completed 10 of 18 passes for 60 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions while adding three rushes for 13 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.

players.name: Trent Sherfield
players.note: Sherfield was elevated to the 53-man roster off the practice squad ahead of Monday's game against Minnesota.

players.name: Stephen Carlson

players.name: DJ Turner
players.note: Turner (ankle) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jalin Hyatt
